caption: The image depicts a grayscale photograph of a rectangular stone slab with six carved relief panels arranged in a grid of two rows and three columns. Each panel contains an individual figure or animal in profile. In the top left panel, there is a depiction of a human figure with legs apart and arms angled downward. The top middle panel features an animal with a curled tail, possibly a lion or similar creature, facing to the right, with a vertical plant near its legs. The top right panel contains an animal, likely a goat or sheep, with curved horns, also facing right. The bottom left panel shows an animal resembling a bull or cow, with noticeable horns, facing right. The bottom middle panel contains a pair of animals, possibly engaging with each other, also facing right. The bottom right panel depicts another animal, possibly a bison or similar creature, with its head lowered. The relief carvings are all enclosed within individual rectangular borders. The surface of the stone appears weathered and exhibits signs of age. The photograph is mounted on an off-white piece of paper, and there is a visible brownish tape stain at the top center of the mounting.
